The '''Dragonbird Gardens''' was a garden complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] that was well-known for its grandeur. [[Orman Tagge|Baron Tagge]], informal leader of the [[Plutocracy|plutocratic]] cabal [[Galactic Corporate Policy League/Legends|Galactic Corporate Policy League]], invited members the League and members of companies with ties to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] to a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long [[Corporate Sector Charter conference|conference]].<ref name="HSCSS" />

[[Gender/Legends|His]] plan for the conference was to establish the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] via the [[Corporate Sector Charter]], in order to capitalize, expand and seize greater control of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. This plan was successful and a charter was created despite great debate and discussion. The League would later formally pitch the concept to the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] who, provided details of the charter from his [[Spy/Legends|spies]], approved the League's plan, seeing great benefit to his own plans for complete dominion over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="HSCSS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dragonbird Gardens were mentioned in [[Michael Allen Horne]]'s [[1993]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="HSCSS" />
